newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Karinos listing delayed to July 22.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Karinos listing delayed to July 22.

text.p: South African food company Karinos Foods Ltd said on Monday that its planned listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange had been delayed until July 22 following a dispute over its abbreviated name.

The company said in a statement that the JSE had received an objection to the proposed abbreviated name K-Foods and in resolving the issue the exchange had decided to extend both the offer period and the listing date.
Karinos said it would pay interest on moneys received for the period June 24 (the original planned listing date) to July 22.
